black_sun_dial: Each ground tile you remove or @kw(burst) gives your next attack +3 damage, up to +9.
hourglass_splinter: When you play a card that costs 6 or more @term(time), your next card this turn costs 2 less Time.
overclock_coil: When you @kw(empower) a card, your next card this turn costs 2 less Time.
echoing_blade: When a @kw(follow_up) bonus applies, your next card this turn costs 1 less Time. Your next card this turn deals 2 more damage.
